description: Integration gate for the composed LMARS gnomonic cubed-sphere shallow-water RHS (problems/duo_swe.esm, model DuoSWFreestream, test freestream_rest_preservation) at fixed resolution N=8 (C8). Runs the full three-prognostic system -- D(dp)/dt = flux_divergence_duo_g3 (LMARS continuity), D(ua)/dt & D(va)/dt = momentum_{u,v}_duo_g3 (Coriolis + upwinded vorticity + kinetic energy) + pgrad_l97_{u,v}_duo_g3 (L97 four-corner pressure gradient) -- through each binding's official simulation pathway from a rest initial state. The composed RHS is exactly zero at rest, so this proves the whole duo spatial core (geometry chain, 3-layer donor-cube halo duo_extend, volume-mean reconstruction, LMARS solve, metric raise-then-reconstruct) lowers and integrates as one field system without match conflict, and preserves the free stream. The per-rule discretizations are pinned separately by the duo ast conformance cases; this manifest routes the runners (assertions + tolerances live in the problem). Python is REQUIRED as of EarthSciAST caea886aa (whole-box broadcast contraction in the numpy interpreter): full gate 6/6 PASS in 2688 s measured 2026-08-29 under CPU contention.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator

blocked_upstream_bindings.rust: Rust does NOT complete this case in CI-tolerable time as of EarthSciAST 9a81afd8b (dev profile at opt-level 2, the run-rust.sh build): the momentum-side rules fall off the taped evaluator (RhsStats: duo_swe_dp already shows 24 fallback rules against 60 taped; its RHS costs 332 ms) and this case's per-RHS cost is >= minutes — the full pde-tests invocation was killed at 2400 s wall, and even rhs_bench (compile + 6 RHS evaluations) exceeded 1800 s. MEASURED 2026-08-28 on duo_swe_ua; duo_swe_va and the full duo_swe freestream system are strictly larger. The sibling duo_swe_dp case IS armed for Rust (49 s, passes; the shape fix in EarthSciAST 64cb58335 unblocked it). Re-arm when the Rust taped/vectorized evaluator covers the esm-spec 9.6.8 reduced-rank/contracted makearray region values the duo momentum rules lower to — the same construct EarthSciAST fd81e922f taught the Julia affine stencilizer and EarthSciAST caea886aa taught the Python numpy interpreter (which re-armed python on this case).
